exposure: Non-acidemic neonates with pH ≥7.2 in cord artery and vein, and Apgar scores ≥9 at five and ten minutes
Neonates with pH <7.1 in umbilical cord artery or vein at cesarean delivery
outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of CTG templates
cohort: 73 neonates with pH <7.1 at birth and 219 non-acidemic neonates
finding: The SWE-09 cardiotocography template demonstrated superior ability to identify fetal acidosis compared to the FIGO-15 and SWE-17 templates, with a higher sensitivity and strong interobserver agreement.
